an10.29:1.1: yāvatā bhikkhave kāsikosalā yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggamakkhāyati

an10.29:1.4: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati pageva hīnasmiṃ

an10.29:2.3: yāvatā bhikkhave sahassalokadhātu mahābrahmā tattha aggamakkhāyati
an10.29:2.4: mahābrahmunopi kho bhikkhave attheva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo
an10.29:2.5: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmiṃpi nibbindati
an10.29:2.6: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:3.1: hoti so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati
an10.29:3.2: saṃvaṭṭamāne bhikkhave loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassaravattanikā bhavanti
an10.29:3.3: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhe carā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti
an10.29:3.4: saṃvaṭṭamāne bhikkhave loke ābhassarā devā aggamakkhāyati
an10.29:3.5: ābhassarānaṃpi kho bhikkhave devānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo
an10.29:3.6: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmiṃpi nibbindati
an10.29:3.7: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati pageva hīnasminti.

an10.29:21.1: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññapenti
an10.29:21.2: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññapentānaṃ yadidaṃ channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca aṭṭhaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimokkho
an10.29:21.3: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti na
an10.29:21.4: samaṇo gotamo kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññapeti na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññapeti na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññapetīti
an10.29:21.5: kāmānañcāhaṃ bhikkhave pariññaṃ paññapemi rūpānañca pariññaṃ paññapemi vedanānañca pariññaṃ paññapemi diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto anupādā parinibbānaṃ paññapemīti.
